changelog:
* **docs: relocate social badges and ignore local opencode dir** (2ef1353)
  - Move Visitors, Stars, Forks and Contributors badges from the top row to below the Open Source, License and Issues badges.
  - Ignore the .opencode directory in .gitignore so local agent config stays untracked.
* **fix: resolve release compile errors** (7d2370f)
  - Pass LocalIndication to clickable and toggleable so the required indication parameter is supplied.
  - Type the press-scale animation specs so tween and spring can infer their type arguments.
  - Compare against TextUnit.Unspecified instead of the unimported isSpecified extension.
  - Make cleanupLegacyOtaApk return Unit instead of the Boolean/Unit try-catch union.
* **feat: polish animations app-wide** (6940c50)
  - Add ui/animation/AppMotion.kt with shared durations, easings, and transitions.
  - Cross-fade bottom-tab switches; eased slide+fade for sub-screen pushes.
  - Animate UpdateScreen status and onboarding page changes via AnimatedContent.
  - Animate Save FAB show/hide with scale and fade.
  - Add subtle press-scale micro-interaction to cards, rows, and buttons.
  - Restore clipped ripples on settings rows, toggle rows, dashboard icon, about rows.
  - Animate dashboard stats row in/out; ease the grand-total count-up.
  - Respect the system remove-animations setting everywhere.
* **feat: hide Save button when count is empty** (eb704c1)
  - Save FAB only renders when grand total is above zero.
  - Matches existing guard in onSaveClick; covers rows typed as 0.
* **docs: add live badges and crew credits to README** (32ceb3d)
  - Add realtime stars, forks, and contributor count badges to the header.
  - Add Credits section with the Telegram-crew shoutout grid.
* **feat: compact headers on root screens** (b35bb7c)
  - Add shared CompactTopBar component handling the status bar inset once.
  - Replace default TopAppBar on Calculator, History and Settings screens.
  - Zero out Scaffold content insets so only the header pads the top.
  - Keep title style, colors and all other UI unchanged.
* **feat: scrollbars on all scrollable screens, piece plural** (7cf0c0b)
  - Gate the scrollbar indicator so it renders only when content overflows (size-dependent).
  - Add the indicator to Calculator, About, Settings Detail, Changelog, Report, Onboarding, the quantity picker sheet, and all four Update screen states.
  - Pluralize the pieces label: 1 piece, anything else pieces, in the picker, breakdown header, dashboard stats, and history and draft cards.
* **feat: picker OK flow, auto-fit numbers, clean uninstall** (28c9f95)
  - Add a pending quantity to the picker sheet: presets and the stepper only stage the value, a full-width OK button commits it.
  - Let custom input follow the same pattern, with live row and grand total previews.
  - Add AutoShrinkText so long quantities and totals shrink instead of clipping with ellipsis.
  - Put the Money Master dialog Open and Close buttons side by side with an emoji row.
  - Disable cloud backup so uninstalling wipes all app data and fresh installs stay fresh.
  - Store the OTA APK in app-private storage and clean legacy Downloads leftovers on fresh install.
  - Refresh FILES.md line counts and file list.
